title: POST-FREEZE (addendum_1, descriptive): Composition of the static DIRTY verdicts (X03)
notes: Per static analysis tool: the first row is the share of BASE DIRTY artifacts (F01 frozen rule) that are DIRTY only through this tool (denominator = F01 BASE DIRTY, checked); then its check ids with the most reported blocking findings on the composite BASE (at most 10 per tool, selected once there and reused for the blocks, checked): reported blocking findings and BASE artifacts with >= 1 such finding / BASE artifacts to which the tool applies (= the S02 BASE denominator, checked). Findings of different tools are never added.

POST-FREEZE (study_analysis_001.addendum_1, DECLARED_AFTER_DRY_RUN, declared 2026-10-17; descriptive, not part of the frozen methodology): X03 dirty_composition - post-freeze descriptive; DIRTY means at least one finding the frozen tool configuration marks blocking, not a confirmed defect

IC4: DIRTY means at least one finding the frozen tool configuration marks blocking (dominated by clang-tidy bugprone heuristics, see X03), not a confirmed defect; under the frozen rule findings of entries in analysis-gap states count (sensitivity X02).

definitions.text: BASE: the 1,980 base cells (pilot_002 396 + full_ext_001 1,584), iteration-0 artifacts (use: initial code quality)
X03 dirty_composition: numerator = artifacts / findings; denominator = DIRTY artifacts (only-via share); BASE artifacts to which the tool applies (check-id artifact share); unit = artifact / finding.
F01 static_verdict_three_state: numerator = artifacts per state; denominator = artifacts; unit = artifact.
